description: Submit a SWSD catalog request, creating an incident with `is_service_request: true` (auto-set by SWSD on this endpoint) and the supplied form variable values. Use `swsd_list_catalog_items` to find the right `catalog_item_id` and `swsd_get_catalog_item` to inspect its variables before filling. Each `request_variables` entry needs `custom_field_id` (= the catalog item variable's `id`) and `value` (stringified to match the variable's `kind` — for dropdowns, one of the `options` choices). The created incident's id is returned for follow-up calls (swsd_get_incident, swsd_assign_incident, etc.). WRITE — does not retry on transient failure; the agent should verify with swsd_get_incident before retrying. To set tenant-specific custom field values, pass `custom_fields: [{name, value}]` — call swsd_describe_custom_fields first to discover field names and (for Dropdowns) allowed values. Validated for Text, Dropdown, Number, Checkbox, and Date types.

catalog_item_id.description: Catalog item id from `swsd_list_catalog_items` or `swsd_get_catalog_item`. The endpoint URL embeds this; SWSD auto-populates the resulting incident's name, category, and subcategory from the catalog item.

custom_fields.description: Set tenant-specific custom field values on the record. Multi_picklist and User-type fields are not yet supported by this tool (set those via the SWSD UI). Validated for Text, Dropdown, Number, Checkbox, and Date types.

name.description: Custom field name (case-sensitive, matches the field as displayed in the SWSD UI). Use swsd_describe_custom_fields first to discover the available field names and their types/allowed values.

value.description: Value to set. For Date use ISO 8601 ("YYYY-MM-DD"); SWSD echoes back as "Mon DD, YYYY" on read. For Dropdown use one of the values from the field schema. For Checkbox use "Yes" or "No". For Number pass a number.

description.description: Optional free-text description added to the resulting incident. The catalog item's default description from the SWSD UI is replaced if you pass this.

request_variables.description: Form variable values, one entry per catalog variable being filled. Use `swsd_get_catalog_item` first to discover the available variables and required ones (`required: "1"`).

custom_field_id.description: The catalog item variable id. Get it from `swsd_get_catalog_item` -> `item.variables[*].id`.

value.description: Stringified value to set on this variable. For dropdowns, use one of the variable's `options` choices verbatim. For dates, use the catalog item's expected format (often "YYYY-MM-DD" or "M/D/YYYY @ HHam/pm").

requester_email.description: Email of the user the request is for. Defaults to the authenticated user (resolved from the JWT). SWSD rejects numeric requester ids on this endpoint, so pass an email if you need to file the request on behalf of someone else.

name: swsd_create_service_request

url.description: SWSD UI URL for the created service-request incident (from href_account_domain).
